provenance: NEXT curated source truth. Original 12 v1 tasks retained unchanged. New selections are manually read direct call/import/type references or explicit unresolved dispatches, not graph-derived answers. Each exact assertion is counted once, not relabeled across categories. Public repositories were independently cloned from each task repository_url into separate read-only fixtures; HEAD plus full-file and inclusive raw-line SHA-256 anchors pin provenance. No source bodies, key values or secrets are copied into this manifest. All public evidence is heldout, and no evidence file crosses splits. Category impact means a source dependency worth reviewing if the target changes, not an executed patch or a bug. UNRESOLVED has no target evidence and never denotes a positive edge. Negative distractors are bounded identifier absence only. This is a 210-assertion Python, Go, Java, TypeScript and Rust slice, not an exhaustive benchmark claim.
